title: Mineral water on the terracotta ledge

tokens.v: EXTREME MACRO — three centimetres of neck, crown cap and the condensation field beneath fill the frame; disregard every mid-shot, whole-bottle and ledge-corner framing instruction in this brief. 100mm macro at f/5.6, framed 1:1 life-size, lens level with the cap's crimped skirt. One bead has just let go and is running, cutting a clear lane through the fog of smaller beads. Unfocused terracotta grit crosses the bottom edge, cut left and right. BASALT BLOOM is lithographed small around the cap's pressed dome, a crimp flute pinching one letter, a bead magnifying another. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
